targetType.description: Transforms the canonical obj to only this targetType.

doNotThrowError.description:
Do not throw the error if transformation fails. Instead, returns errors field populated in
CanonicalTransformResult.

defaultTimestamp.description: Timestamp to use for the timed value fields if Canonical.timestamp is not populated.

metaOverride.description: Meta obj with fields to override in the target obj's meta.

withTargetDefaults.description:
Specifies that, for target obj, all fields which have a default value declared and were not provided
in src obj, will be populated with the default value.

title: Specifies parameters for transforming canonical content.
name: SourceTransformSpec
